searchText: Are you suppose to receive an invite to the EPF Google group via email upon submitting an application or upon acceptance into the fellowship? I applied on the 2nd and never got an email It will be send to all applicants at the same time when applications close Applications are opened till end of this week. If you'd like to participate, don't hesitate to apply, here is the form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1N-9PFEXW5KKqFH6NzArcqnI4YdTULh4xpmh6chRm8JI/edit To learn more about EPF, check the program details https://github.com/eth-protocol-fellows/cohort-three/blob/master/program-guide/program-details.md and FAQ https://github.com/eth-protocol-fellows/cohort-three/blob/master/program-guide/faq.md And feel free to reach out to me or <@914307919699406908> if you have any questions! Appreciate it. If you're in Berlin, have fun! Happ Merge 🐼
